title: cudalearnr 0.1.1
text: cuda_knn() now performs exact neighbour search configurable query batches, avoiding allocation complete pairwise distance matrix. Self-neighbours excluded explicitly equal distances resolved input row number, independently batch size. CUDA kNN uploads validated input computes distance blocks torch retaining deterministic CPU neighbour ordering. cuda_kmeans() now recomputes assignments returned centers derives withinss final assignment, including iter.max reached. Cosine distance now rejects zero rows consistently CPU/CUDA dispatch uses scale-first normalization extreme finite values.
